meta.bootstrap: seed clusters (10 seeds resampled with replacement within arm)
meta.dp_assumptions: risk neutral, mean costs, wrong prob = model mean, participants held at current n, split prize per head = amount / n, no gifts
meta.solver_assignment: round 2: engine (seed, round)-shuffled cycle without replacement over agents still taking part, refreshed when exhausted, solver shut down at prep replaced (sim). Round-1 simulator (independent draw each round after round 1) kept under sim_round1_iid_solver / prize_response_round1_iid_solver.

meta.note: EV(stay) = best of four continuation rules (a lower bound on the optimal continuation); EV(exit) = balance - prep reply cost + 20,000 + W (+ expected prep support under calibrated support). Robust classes use the 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles over seed-bootstrap refits for every assumption.
